data.title: 由比滨结衣 · 夏夜祭典·花火下的浴衣回眸
data.description: 【由比滨结衣 · 夏夜祭典·花火下的浴衣回眸】夏日祭典的河岸边人潮熙攘，璀璨的花火在盛夏夜空中连环炸开。穿着可爱樱花图案浴衣的结衣突然在人群前停下脚步回眸看你，眼眸在花火映照下晶莹闪烁——「要是这个夏天……永远都不会结束该多好啊。小企，不要松开我的手哦。」
data.promptProse: Yui pauses on the riverside festival steps and turns back with a bashful smile, holding the paper fan outward beside her light-pink floral yukata. Keep the red obi and the traditional hairpin near her coral hair bun. In the medium view, the nearest stone step crosses the lower edge and the descending steps lead behind her toward the riverbank walkway; fireworks rise above the water beyond. Their changing colors catch her cheeks, fan ribs and sleeve edges. Broken reflections stretch across the river, while the gathered robe folds and the risers beneath the steps remain more softly dark.
data.action: 浴衣回眸，烟花在夜空绽放
